components.description: Up to 60 calendar days of leave in a 52-week period for the faculty member's own serious illness or major disability, or to care for a seriously ill child, dependent, spouse, domestic partner or parent; the leave status (its pay is c2, U6). Same terms in Section I(a) (nine-month faculty) and II(b) (twelve-month faculty).
components.mechanism_note: U6: the policy grants a paid leave of absence ('shall ... be granted up to sixty calendar days of paid leave'); coded as the leave (this component) plus its pay (c2, generic plan within it). The leave also serves family care (U5).

components.relief_note: A formal leave of absence; no relief stated (R9).

components.duration_note: Per increment up to 12 months; total of extensions under (ii) and (iii) up to 24 months; a second 12-month request needs the same paperwork. A request in the third or fourth year of an initial assistant-professor term is conditional on renewal of the appointment (flagged).
components.notice: initiated not later than 24 months before the end of the term (2.c.(6)(iv); tenure-clock page)

notes: Governing document: 2018_00, the Faculty Serious Illness, Major Disability, and Parental Leave Policy (effective August 19, 2004; capture 2018-02-07), covering nine-month faculty (Section I) and twelve-month faculty and tenure-stream senior administrators (Section II). Faculty are not unionised. missing = false.

2018_05 is an index page and holds no policy text. 2018_01 (FAQ), 2018_03 (leave summary) and 2018_06 (tenure-clock page) are summaries; 2018_07 (Trustee tenure policies, amended through 10/20/2009) predates amendments in force on the reference date, so components citing it carry version_uncertain.

Member path (U8): a nine-month tenure-stream faculty member who carries teaching responsibilities: parental leave is a full semester of paid leave (c3). Other paths in notes: nine-month primary caregivers without teaching, up to fifteen weeks paid; twelve-month faculty (c10), a semester or fifteen weeks of leave paid only from their own accrued sick and vacation leave. Employees not eligible for FMLA: the FMLA page says a request for up to 12 weeks of leave without pay for a birth or adoption 'must be approved by department management' (recorded here per U8, not as a component).

Calendar: the documents state a semester calendar ('a full semester', '[Fall/Spring] semesters') but no term length; footnote 6's 'thirty-five weeks (approximately two full [Fall/Spring] semesters)' defines FMLA hours, not the term, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Chain, birth parent: serious illness leave up to 60 calendar days (c1, paid by the generic plan c2 within it) and the parental leave of one semester (c3, paid), joined also_available ('In addition'); FMLA 12 weeks (c4) concurrent with both from the start; short-term disability (c6, Disability Income Plan) consecutive_after the 60 paid days, length not stated.

Chain, non-birth parent: family-care serious illness leave up to 60 calendar days (c1/c2, care of the spouse) also_available with the parental leave of one semester (c3, primary caregiver only); FMLA (c4) concurrent from the start; North Carolina family illness leave up to 52 weeks (c5) consecutive_after FMLA.
Dual-employee rule: where both parents work for the University, parental leave in aggregate is one semester or fifteen weeks, taken by the primary caregiver (III(c)(ii)).

Documents cited but not saved: 300.2.11 Policy on Serious Illness and Disability Leave for Faculty and 300.2.11[G] Guidelines (UNC policy manual); Faculty Serious Illness Policy at a Glance; Faculty Parental Leave Policy at a Glance; Voluntary Shared Leave policy; Leave Without Pay policy (and Leave Without Pay for SPA Employees); Disability Income Plan; North Carolina family illness leave statute; Bonus Leave; Community Service Leave; Faculty Military Leave; Family & Medical Leave Summary; FMLA Military Caregiver/Qualifying Exigency Leave; Guidelines on Faculty Leave Payout or Transfer; Research and Study Leaves; Faculty Leave Accrual Provost Memo; Faculty Leave Payout Provost Memo; Leave Policy for Certain Faculty Members; Sick Leave for SPA Employees; Determining Time Worked; the Trustee tenure policies as amended 5/26/2011, 7/24/2014 and 3/23/2017; UNC Policy Manual 101.3.1, 200.6, 300.1.1, 300.2.1 (unrelated to leave).

Not components: Section I(d)/II(e) (leaves do not accumulate); IV(b) benefits continuation; the FMLA page's reduced or intermittent schedule and temporary reassignment for planned medical treatment (part of FMLA, c4); 'extended leaves of absence with or without compensation' mentioned only as excluded from the tenure-extension provisions; Research and Study Leaves (index only, not saved, not for parents).
